title: Identify the name and date of the event that had the highest total spent on
question: Identify the name and date of the event that had the highest total spent on 'Advertisement', among only those events held at 'MU 215' with at least two distinct expense items exceeding $75 each.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_011", T1."XCL_012"
FROM event AS T1
INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1."XCL_010" = T2."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2."XCL_003" = T3."XCL_023"
WHERE T1."XCL_015" = 'MU 215'
  AND T2."XCL_004" = 'Advertisement'
  AND T1."XCL_010" IN (
      SELECT T1b."XCL_010"
      FROM event AS T1b
      INNER JOIN budget AS T2b ON T1b."XCL_010" = T2b."XCL_009"
      INNER JOIN expense AS T3b ON T2b."XCL_003" = T3b."XCL_023"
      WHERE T1b."XCL_015" = 'MU 215'
        AND T3b."XCL_020" > 75
      GROUP BY T1b."XCL_010"
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T3b."XCL_017") >= 2
  )
GROUP BY T1."XCL_010", T1."XCL_011", T1."XCL_012"
ORDER BY SUM(T3."XCL_020") DESC
LIMIT 1
